purpose: W6-D: generalize the existing fail-closed regulatory control tower/FGIS Grain corridor into a provider-neutral GovernmentGateway with versioned applicability, receipts, reporting and degraded-state authority for FGIS Grain, EFGIS ZSN, Seed, Saturn and phytosanitary corridors without claiming unavailable government access.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. Staged only; no implementation authority before separate governance review/merge and immutable base-state promotion.
requiredInvariants: Reuse the existing regulatory control-tower durability/redrive/evidence and FGIS Grain fail-closed inbox patterns; do not create a second integration inbox/outbox or duplicate Deal/Inventory authority.

GovernmentGateway core is corridor/provider-neutral. Each corridor declares capabilities, schema/profile versions, authentication mode, direction, freshness/SLA and receipt semantics; external system-specific payloads stay behind mappers.

RegulatoryApplicability is versioned and server-derived from canonical commodity profile, operation, geography, party/facility facts, dates and authoritative rule sources. The browser cannot select which regulations apply.
Applicability distinguishes REQUIRED, NOT_APPLICABLE, UNKNOWN_REVIEW_REQUIRED and BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_FACTS. Unknown/degraded external availability cannot silently become NOT_APPLICABLE.

Outbound REQUEST_ACCEPTED/QUEUED and inbound payload arrival are not regulatory success. Only validated immutable government/provider receipts bound to exact request/object/version/identity may create an accepted external fact.
A corridor without live contract, credentials, endpoints, certificates/keys or accepted conformance evidence remains NOT_ACTIVATED/EXTERNAL_BLOCKER and must never emit successful government status.
FGIS Grain preserves its existing stronger fail-closed behavior; generalization cannot weaken its inbox, provenance, idempotency, tenant isolation, source health or evidence freshness controls.
EFGIS ZSN, Seed, Saturn and phytosanitary corridors begin as explicit NOT_ACTIVATED reference adapters until official access contracts and mappings exist.
Regulatory reporting is an immutable versioned obligation/report/receipt chain. Generating or sending a report does not prove authority acceptance until a validated receipt is attached.

Degraded external mode preserves local deal/evidence work only where the pinned regulatory policy permits it; legally blocked actions remain fail-closed and show exact missing corridor/evidence reason.
No manual upload or operator override can manufacture official external success; manual evidence has explicit provenance/status and can only satisfy policy if that policy explicitly permits it.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, Inventory/Progressive Trust/Document authorities, packages/lockfiles and REG.RU-only production remain unchanged.
acceptance: Contract tests prove one common gateway/applicability/receipt vocabulary supports all five named corridors without system-specific core fields.
Applicability tests cover REQUIRED/NOT_APPLICABLE/UNKNOWN/BLOCKED outcomes and prove missing/unknown facts never downgrade a mandatory obligation.
Reference corridors are NOT_ACTIVATED without live credentials/config and cannot fabricate government receipts or statuses.
Receipt tests reject wrong object/version/tenant/provider/request, duplicate/replayed event, stale certificate/key and payload fingerprint mismatch.
Existing FGIS Grain fail-closed/inbox/redrive tests remain green and are not weakened by the generalized router.
Degraded-mode tests prove permitted local actions stay available while legally significant blocked actions remain fail closed with reason codes.
No credentials, secrets or paid dependency are committed by the foundation; mandatory recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
Exact-head review plus corridor-specific official/credentialed REG.RU acceptance is required before each terminal corridor receives PASS.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Official contracts, credentials, endpoint/schema documentation and certificates for each government corridor are external dependencies.
Each corridor requires its own production mapping/conformance/receipt and revocation/freshness evidence before terminal credit.
Progressive Trust/Inventory/Documents must consume accepted corridor facts through explicit adapters before end-to-end regulatory PASS.
REG.RU production operations, outage and recovery evidence remain mandatory.
